title: chamaecrista belemii
intro: Chamaecrista belemii, commonly known as the Pará butterfly-pea, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chamaecrista belemii include protecting against oxidative stress, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting antinociceptive effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
